headline: Dominican Republic surpasses 10 MM visitors through October
summary: The Dominican Republic welcomed 10,043,476 visitors from January to October 2026, up 8.2% year on year, with 7,760,625 arriving by air, according to the tourism ministry.
why: Tourism is a major source of foreign-currency earnings and employment for the Dominican Republic, so visitor trends feed directly into its economic growth.
original_headline: República Dominicana supera los 10 MM de visitantes hasta octubre
